# Synthetic registry for the bad-citations fixture

```toml
[SyntheticUpstream]
anchor_version = "1.0.0"
anchor_sha     = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"
vendor_root    = "references/SyntheticUpstream"
anchor_doc     = "README.md"
upstream_url   = "https://example.com/synthetic-upstream"
used_by_checks = ["cat1.upstream-citation"]
```

Outside the fence is ignored by the parser.
